data.heading: Problem 1 — Passiv shaklda ifodalash
data.problem:
Izoh: Quyidagi aktiv gaplarni passiv shaklga o'qing.
1. People make this car in Germany.
2. Somebody stole my bicycle yesterday.

steps.text: 1-qadam: Aktiv gapning tarkibini aniqlang. 1-gapda 'people' (subekt) va 'make' (fe'l) bor.
2-qadam: Passiv qurilmani tuzing. 'be' fe'li va o'tgan z participle shaklidan foydalanamiz: 'is made'.
3-qadam: Subekt va ob'ektni o'rnini almashtiring. 'this car' yangi subektga aylanadi.
4-qadam: Yakuniy javob: 'This car is made in Germany.'
2-misol uchun xuddi shu jarayonni takrorlang: 'My bicycle was stolen yesterday.'

data.result:
1. This car is made in Germany.
2. My bicycle was stolen yesterday.

narr: Keling, birinchi misolni ko'rib chiqaylik. Aktiv gap 'People make this car in Germany'. Passivga o'tganda, 'this car' subektga aylanadi va 'is made' fe'li hosil qilinadi.
Ikkinchi misolda 'Somebody stole my bicycle yesterday' gapida kim o'g'riligini bilmaymiz, shuning uchun passiv shakl juda foydali bo'ladi. Javob: 'My bicycle was stolen yesterday.'
Bu haftalarda biz passiv ovozni o'rganamiz. Passiv ovoz ilmiy va texnik jarayonlarda juda ko'p ishlatiladi.
Passiv ovozning asosiy qo'llanilish holatlari: harakatni kim bajargani aniq bo'lmaganda, harakatni kim bajargani muhim bo'lmaganda va faqat rasmiy nutqda.

data.heading: Jarayonni ketma-ketlik bilan bayon qilish
bullets: Ravishlardan foydalaning: firstly, then, next, after that, finally
Bog'liqlikni ko'rsatish uchun: after, as, as soon as, once, when

narr: Jarayonni ketma-ketlik bilan bayon qilish usullarini ko'rib chiqamiz.
Ravishlardan foydalanishingiz mumkin: firstly, then, next, after that, finally. Masalan: 'Firstly, some energy is removed by the clouds.'
Ikki voqea o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni ko'rsatish uchun after, as, as soon as, once va when kabi so'zlarni ishlatishingiz mumkin. Masalan: 'As soon as sunlight hits the flower, its petals open.'
'At this stage' iborasi aniq ketma-ketlik yaratishga yordam beradi. Masalan: 'The temperature reaches 100°C. At this stage, the water in the container begins to boil.'
Endi 5-hafta ma'ruzasining birinchi qismiga o'tamiz. Bu yerda passiv o'voz haqida savollar va javoblar ko'rib chiqiladi.

data.heading: O'sish va kamayishni ifodalash fe'llari
bullets: Grafiklar raqamlar qanday ortishi yoki kamayishini ko'rsatadi. Raqamlar, bundan tashqari, rise yoki grow ham deyilib fall, drop yoki decline deb aytiladi. O'sish haqida ishlatiladigan boshqa fe'llar qatoriga double, soar, multiply, appreciate va exceed [boshqa raqam] kiradi: double = raqam yoki miqdorning ikki barobariga oshishi; antonimi = halve; soar = juda tez va katta miqdorda oshish; antonimi = plummet; multiply = juda katta songa ko'payish; appreciate = qiymatning oshishi; antonimi = depreciate; exceed = muayyan raqam yoki miqdordan yuqoriga oshish; antonimi = fall below.

Til yordami. increase va decrease fe'llaridan keyin by keladi (masalan, The population of the city has increased by 10%). increase, rise, growth, fall, drop hamda decline, decrease otlaridan keyin in (nima ortayotganini tushuntirish uchun) yoki of (o'zgarish hajmini tushuntirish uchun) keladi, masalan: a rise / an increase of 15% in the number of cars.

narr: Grafiklardagi ma'lumotlarning o'zgarishini tavsirlashda turli fe'llardan foydalanamiz. Raqamlarning o'sishini 'rise' yoki 'grow' deb, kamayishini esa 'fall', 'drop' yoki 'decline' deb atash mumkin.

O'sishni ifodalashda boshqa fe'llardan ham foydalanamiz. 'Double' - bu raqamning ikki barobariga oshishi, antonimi 'halve'. 'Soar' - juda tez va katta miqdorda oshish, antonimi 'plummet'. 'Multiply' - juda katta songa ko'payish. 'Appreciate' - qiymatning oshishi, antonimi 'depreciate'. 'Exceed' - muayyan raqamdan yuqoriga oshish, antonimi 'fall below'.

Fe'llardan keyin 'by' keladi, masalan: 'The population has increased by 10%'. Otlardan keyin esa 'in' yoki 'of' keladi. 'In' nima ortayotganini, 'of' esa o'zgarish hajmini tushuntiradi, masalan: 'a rise of 15% in the number of cars'.
